learnings: Single-source the tool's code and generate the docs from the real parser, so they never drift apart.
A pre-flight check blocks releases that lack a changelog entry, licence, tests or up-to-date docs.
Trusted publishing (`id-token: write`) uploads to TestPyPI without storing an API token.
pitfalls: Bumping the version without a matching changelog entry confuses users about what changed.
